method: Independent roles per row: an architecture auditor (Opus 5.5) reconciled clauses to code and diffs; a separate tester (Sonnet 5.5) ran the planned tests and rechecked decisive claims; new tests were written by a coder and verified by a different tester with single-edit product mutations and byte-verified restore. Nobody verified their own work.
scope: Verification carry of PM-1 F01-03 (shared UI and journey visibility, target staging) with Node UI tests only (no browser), and two UI fixes. Evidence for a later successor scorecard; no staging readback.

F01-03.reconciliation: Carry reconciled with gaps. Journey labels, explicit unavailable states, the research admission chip, the no-qualified-winner claim, disabled controls and Thai/English labels match their server sources; 228 Node UI tests passed across 16 files.

setupGuide.summary: The setup guide now shows Bridge-dependent steps as unavailable when a release disables the Bridge (bridge_enabled false or missing).
setupGuide.tests: 4 new cases (English and Thai); 3 of 3 mutations killed.

journeyCopy.summary: Owner decision D2: the next-step texts of journey steps 2 to 5 now state what is done and what is still open, each with cited evidence; an independent evidence review checked every changed string.
journeyCopy.tests: Journey UI 19 of 19 and related UI suites passed.

limits: Rendered desktop and mobile layout was not checked in a browser.
Staging still serves the earlier UI bytes, so the two fixes are not on staging.

rootAcceptance.statement: Root reviewed the reconciliation, both fixes and their independent checks and accepted them as local engineering evidence.
